summary: All 12 target episodes promoted to exact records. The S1 reorder shape is now fully resolved: ep1=1-3, then the anime swaps the school/Kurama chapters ahead of the matchmaking chapters (ep2=4+7-8, ep3=5-6), pulls the Mizuki kidnapping forward (ep4=14-16) ahead of the Narukami arc (ep5=9-12), then runs linearly 17-24 (eps 6-9). Two surprises: ep10 is a heavy rework of ch 25 (the summer-festival beats restaged as a Christmas goukon, plus a flashback grafting past-arc material the OADs later adapt), and ep11 is a forward GRAFT from volume 7 (chs 37-38: Mizuki-in-town + amusement-park/hairpin date) - i.e. the stored 'S1 inside chs 1-30' zone claim is wrong for ep11 specifically, though the ch-30/31 season boundary itself stays clean (ch 31 opens the morning after the ch-30 festival). Ch 13 (moon-viewing party) is skipped entirely by the anime; it is the honest continue point after ep5. Ep12 interleaves 26/29/27/28 with the Otohiko test heavily altered (miasma test replaces the manga's grading + fake-Tomoe test).

anchors.note: Meets Mikage/shrine (ch1), leaves shrine + netherworld (ch2), demon-hag rescue + contract kiss (ch3); ep2 opens exactly at ch4's renovated-shrine morning. TV Tropes states ep1 covers chs 1-3; fandom ep infobox lists ch 1 (incomplete).

Ch4 (divine-power/water-to-wine test) then skips over 5-6 to the Kurama school arc chs 7-8 (TV debut, targeting, ostrich). Ch4's tail (Himemiko's arrival) is held back for ep3. Non-monotonic by design.
Himemiko/Kotarou matchmaking (Tatara Swamp) = manga chs 5-6, aired AFTER chs 7-8 (swap with ep2). Opens from ch4's tail (Himemiko procession arrives).

White snake/mark (ch14), kidnap to Yonomori + Mizuki proposal (ch15), Tomoe's rescue, shrine-burning + plum tree, Yonomori backstory (ch16) - vol 3 material pulled ahead of the Narukami arc. HOLE-grade start: 14.

Full Narukami arc (mark stolen, Tomoe shrunk, Kurama's house, recovery + re-contract) = chs 9-12, aired after 14-16. Anime addition: Otohiko shown as instigator behind Narukami (TV Tropes). end+1=13 is also the honest continue (ch 13 unadapted).
Cold/Tomoe-as-Nanami at school + Ami saved from yokai (ch17), Mizuki's shrine visit + warning about Tomoe (ch18). Ep7 opens with Ami wanting to thank Kurama 'for yesterday' = ch19 seam.
'Air' talisman Ami/Kurama setup (ch19); aquarium date, confession, tower-edge fall, 'never touch again' promise (ch20). Wikipedia and fandom summaries both match chapter events exactly.

Beach + Ami drowning (ch21; anime attributes it to Otohiko), Dragon King's shell abduction, debt/2-day quest, and ch22's tail (Time Rotation Incense Burner departure) closes the ep. Ep9 opens at ch23's first panel.
Yukiji house scene, Isohime, Mizuki's familiar kiss (ch23); Ryugu journey/Kamehime haori, palace rescue (ch24). Fandom ep plot tracks the two chapter summaries beat for beat. HOLE-grade start: 23.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 25 (beats reworked: goukon replaces the summer-festival setting; flashback half grafts past-arc material later depicted ~chs 96-101, cf. OADs)
anchors.note: Event-level derivation: ch25's distinctive beats (Mizuki's waiting-for-master frame, full-moon sake wish, boys flirting with the girls + Tomoe/Mizuki intervention) are restaged as the Christmas mixer; mixer boy Kohirui Maki exists nowhere in the manga. 'Tomoe Becomes a Familiar' half (Mikage saves cursed Tomoe, erases Yukiji) grafts past-arc material. No source states the mapping outright.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 37-38 (vol 7 graft: Mizuki-in-town = ch 37; amusement-park date + hairpin gift = ch 38)
anchors.note: Forward graft from vol 7, outside the stored {1-30} zone. Ch37's wiki summary (Mizuki to Tokyo/Kurama, Edo line, sticker scam, launch party) matches ep11a beat for beat, corroborated by Viz's vol 7 blurb; the Hairpin item page maps the hairpin debut to Anime=Episode 11 / Manga=Chapter 038, matching Wikipedia's ep11 summary (amusement park + hairpin). Ch38 page is a stub, so the exact staging of the date rests on the item-page mapping.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 26, 29, 27-28 (interleaved; Otohiko's test and the despair/leaving heavily altered)
anchors.note: Running order: haunted-shrine gossip + festival decision (ch26) -> prep/posters with Kurama's festival gift (ch29 fragment) -> kagura/kimono + Otohiko's test, restaged as a miasma-purification test (ch27 altered; manga has grading + fake-Tomoe) -> despair and leaving (ch28 inverted: in manga 'Tomoe' leaves, in anime Nanami does). END=28 honest last mainline chapter in running order.

after ep3 the viewer has seen chs 1-8; resume at 9 (Narukami arc, aired later as ep5)

annotation_updates.note: corrected zone facts: ep11 adapts vol 7 chs 37-38 grafted into S1, NOT material inside chs 1-30; the 'S1 inside chs 1-30' zone statement holds for eps 1-10 and 12-13 only. The ch30/31 season boundary itself stays clean (ch31 opens the morning after the ch30 festival).

refined zone facts: ep10 = ch25 beats reworked (summer-festival setting replaced by a Christmas goukon with anime-only Kohirui Maki) plus a flashback half grafting past-arc material (Mikage takes in cursed Tomoe; manga depicts this in the ~96-101 region the OADs adapt).

type_corrections.note: typed canon in our rows, but only ch25's beats survive in reworked form; the mixer setting/character are anime-only and the flashback grafts then-unpublished past-arc material

flags_for_sean: ep13 stored anchor's chapters_adapted text ('1-30 (vols 1-5) reordered; finale = 26-30') is now imprecise as a season envelope: S1 also grafts chs 37-38 (vol 7) via ep11. Ep13's own values (END 30, finale 26-30) stand; only the envelope wording needs a touch-up.

ch 13 (Himemiko moon-viewing party) is never adapted anywhere in S1 - it is the honest continue point after ep5 (end+1=13 already, so no continue_points row needed); ch 25's actual summer-festival setting is likewise dropped (only its beats survive in ep10).

S2 overlap check: chs 37-38 are consumed by S1 ep11; stored S2 record is the zone anchor ep25 {31-64 compressed} with no per-episode rows yet - when S2 gets promoted, verify eps 14-24 don't double-map 37-38 (S2 ep synopses suggest it skips them).

ep12 is borderline mixed (miasma-purification test and the run-away framing are anime restagings of chs 27-28); left typed canon since every scene has a manga counterpart beat - flagging rather than correcting.

fandom episode infoboxes are useless here (all 'Manga Chapter(s) = TBA' except ep1 listing only ch 1) - the exact map above rests on TV Tropes (ep1=1-3, Otohiko insertions), cross-correlation of fandom chapter summaries vs fandom+Wikipedia episode summaries, the Viz vol-7 blurb, and the fandom Hairpin item page (ep11=ch38).
